trade_name: NOS ICT Computer Aided Design & Computer Aided Manufacturing

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Workplace Health and Safety Regulations

performance_criteria.description: Explain key OHS legislation and regulations relevant to the IT sector.
Identify the roles and responsibilities of individuals and organizations in maintaining a safe work environment
Describe the process for reporting health and safety risks and incidents.

learning_outcomes.description: Know Workplace Hazards and Implement Control Measures

performance_criteria.description: Identify common hazards in IT work environments, including electrical, ergonomic, and data-related risks
Assess the severity and likelihood of potential hazards in specific IT tasks.
Implement appropriate control measures, such as safe cabling practices, ergonomic workstation setup, and electrical safety protocols.

learning_outcomes.description: Know Emergency Procedures and First Aid in the Workplace

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate the correct procedure for responding to workplace emergencies, such as electrical fires or equipment malfunctions.
Perform basic first aid techniques, including treating minor injuries and using first aid equipment
Communicate effectively with emergency services and other relevant personnel during a workplace incident.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the Roles and Responsibilities within a Team

performance_criteria.description: Identify the different roles and functions within an IT team (e.g., network engineers, system administrators, software developers).
Describe the key responsibilities and contributions of each team member.
Recognize the importance of each role in achieving the team's objectives.

learning_outcomes.description: Know Positive Working Relationships within a Team

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate techniques for effective interpersonal communication and conflict resolution in a team environment.
Show the ability to provide constructive feedback and actively listen to others' contributions
Promote inclusivity and collaboration among team members to ensure participation and engagement from all.

learning_outcomes.description: Contribute to Team Problem-Solving and Decision-Making

performance_criteria.description: Participate in group discussions to identify and analyse IT-related problems.
Suggest innovative solutions and support team decision-making processes.
Evaluate the effectiveness of team decisions and propose improvements where necessary.

learning_outcomes.description: Communicate Technical Information Clearly and Accurately

performance_criteria.description: Explain IT concepts, procedures, and solutions in a manner appropriate to the audience, whether technical or non-technical.
Use industry-standard terminology correctly when describing technical processes
Adapt communication methods to suit the context, such as written reports, emails, or verbal presentations.

learning_outcomes.description: Utilize Digital Communication Tools Effectively

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate proficiency in using digital tools for communication, such as email, messaging platforms, and collaboration software (e.g., Slack, Teams).
Adhere to best practices for professional digital communication, including email etiquette and secure file sharing.
Use collaborative tools to share and receive feedback on documents, code, or project updates.

learning_outcomes.description: Listen and Respond Appropriately in a Professional Context

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate active listening skills during team discussions or client meetings.
Respond to questions, concerns, and feedback clearly and effectively.
Clarify misunderstandings and summarize discussions to ensure mutual understanding.

Use extend tool for editing simple 2D shapes

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the basic principles and concepts of 3D modelling.

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate how to move an object along the X, Y, Z-axis.
Use geometry types: Solid, Surface, and Mesh Modeling for modeling objects.
Use a cylinder as a base for modeling a column or a sphere.

learning_outcomes.description: Know 3D modelling tools in CAD

performance_criteria.description: Use extrude tool to converts 2D shapes into 3D solids.
Create a 3D object by rotating a 2D shape around a specified axis.
Create a 3D object by sweeping a 2D profile along a specified path.
Use loft tool to create a 3D solid by blending multiple 2D shapes positioned on different planes.
Modify the height of walls or create openings in solids using the press-pull tool.

learning_outcomes.description: Know 3D basic modelling tools.

performance_criteria.description: Create basic 3D shapes with primitives.
Create 3D Shapes with extrusion tool.
Create circular objects with revolve tool.
Modify shapes with Boolean operations.
Create simple assemblies combining multiple shapes, to build more complex models

learning_outcomes.description: Understand CAM in modern manufacturing.

performance_criteria.description: Define CAM
Explain the role of CAM in the design-to-manufacturing process.
Differentiate between CAD and CAM
Explain Computer Integrated Manufacturing (CIM).
Explain manufacturing processes that benefit from CAM: • Milling • Turning • Laser cutting, etc.
Explain real-world applications of CAM in industries: • Automotive, • Aerospace, • Consumer goods, etc.
Identify the common CAM software’s (e.g., Mastercam, Fusion 360, Solid CAM).

learning_outcomes.description: Know CNC Milling Machines – Setup and Operation.

performance_criteria.description: Apply safety protocols when working with CNC machines.
Explain milling process, tool types, and machine setup.
Demonstrate proper mounting of cutting tools, setting tool offsets, and zeroing the machine.
Carryout a step-by-step setup of a CNC milling machine,
Perform basic milling operations by writing G & M codes to create slots and pockets.
Perform changing tools and recalibration of machine for different operations.

learning_outcomes.description: Know CNC Lathes and Turning Centres.

performance_criteria.description: Set up a CNC lathe, including workpiece mounting, tool selection, and setting tool offsets.
Create basic cylindrical component from writing G & M codes, to perform turning, facing, and threading operations.
Use threading tools to cut internal and external threads on the lathe.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand CNC Routers – Applications and Operations

performance_criteria.description: Set up a CNC router for cutting a plywood sheet: • Securing the material • Calibrating the machine.
Use pre-programmed toolpaths to cut a simple shape or sign.
Test cutting different materials (wood, plastic, aluminum) to understand machine adjustments.

learning_outcomes.description: Know CNC Precision Cutting Techniques

performance_criteria.description: Cut a simple metal shape using a plasma cutter.
Engrave a small design on acrylic or wood with a laser cutter.
Adjust machine settings for different material thicknesses and types.

learning_outcomes.description: Know CNC Machine Maintenance and Troubleshooting.

performance_criteria.description: Resolve common CNC machine errors: • Tool misalignment, • Programming errors
Perform calibration checks to ensure machine accuracy.
Perform basic maintenance on a CNC machine.
Diagnose a simulated machine error during operation.
Fix machine faults from diagnoses

performance_criteria.description: Explain cutting-edge developments like multi-material printing, large-scale 3D printing, and the use of AI and machine learning to optimise printing processes.
